title: Distinguish minimum information length from the algebraic complexity of that information
statement: For every odd n>=5, the native final reports Q(x)=P(x³) onF_(2^n) with codimension-one linearP: each output has two originals, but no one-bit affine function separates all fibers. One quadratic bit does. In dimension3 a linear bit exists despite failure of the current flag, separating an algorithmic admission failure from an intrinsic linearity obstruction.
